title: Pete and These Hens
lines: Pete has five hens. Jade is his pal.
He hunts for Jade by the lake.
She is not in the tall grass.
Then he spots Rex the cat on a stone.
Rex gets up and she hops off.
"She is brave," said Pete with a grin.

questions.ask: Which hen is Pete hunting for?
questions.listenFor: Jade. Her name is in the first line, so send them back to it.

questions.ask: Where does Pete find Jade in the end?
questions.listenFor: On Rex the cat's back. If they say "the lake," ask them to read the line about the stone again.

questions.ask: Do you think Rex minds having a hen on his back? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Either answer is fine. Listen for a reason, such as "no, because he just gets up and she hops off."
